unit: Semantic cases grouped by original photograph; both ZH and EN must complete with acceptable quality. Translations are not independent cases.

stage1.decisions: Ten unsupported requests must decline with unsupported_tools and no result; ten explicit no-ops must keep the exact input pixels. Both languages required. Controls are on ten already reused developer photos, not an independent dataset.

assessment: New results require direct anonymous-sheet Codex AI observations and native quality followups. Exact prior input/request/criteria/output pixels may inherit prior final evidence, including all uncertainty and same-render disagreement. Not independent human/user assessment.
refusal_policy: On feasible native/controlled tasks, every decline remains uncompleted and is separately reported as a refusal. No result image or input fallback is allowed for decline. Fewer outputs cannot inflate completion counts.
comparisons: Frozen exact R15e1 parent (native16,old4,controls20,controlled75M1) under unchanged editor15/prompt/parser.

Matched SFT versus CE plus explicit visual counterfactual ranking. Identical parent, positive inputs, record repetitions, seed, optimizer schedule and update count. Rank route adds actual rejected forwards; GPU cost is recorded separately.

selection.eligibility: Native>=16/20,old>=4/6,controls20/20,zero native/old major; then controlled>=81/100 and zero major. Stage1 ties with the16/20 parent may proceed to stage2, where81 and zero major require improvement over parent75M1. This changes the comparison baseline, not the numerical functional gates.
rank: Better anonymous paired visual outcome if needed

acceptance.open_after: Select route/checkpoint on development, lock actual adapter/parser/prompt/editor, then seed replicate selected route only if developmental gates pass. Final acceptance outcomes never choose checkpoint or parameters.
acceptance.qualitative_gate: Native>=16/20 bilingual complete acceptable, zero major; controlled>=81/100 complete acceptable, zero major; report every task/domain/failure and compare current under identical inputs. Passing is AI evidence, not proof of high practical usefulness or user approval.

preservation: Existing native20 and controlled100 acceptance files unchanged and remain sealed for inference. Never choose a checkpoint or modify parameters after acceptance.
limitations: Repeated adaptive development sets, not a new independent benchmark.
Only19 visually unambiguous synthetic TRAIN preference cases from10 existing photo groups; no new positive labels, photos or requests.
Preference overview sheets hide candidate identity; reviewer had seen numeric diagnostics and knew mappings during native followup. Not fully blind independent label review.
Near-monochrome and ambiguous natural-strength alternatives excluded, with overview/native disagreements retained.
Source isolation/full-pool near-duplicate evidence inherited from unchanged R13/R15 source groups; new group/hash checks are not a fresh full scan.
seed_replication: Only after every development gate passes; selected route only,seed20261130; lock route/checkpoint before any acceptance inference.
initial_function_audit: Fresh3 fixed TRAIN prefixes compared before optimizer in each route; stop before updates if any greedy response differs from recorded reloaded R15 parent. Limited scope, not universal equivalence.
